  (∃ x_3 ∈ x.records, ((x_3.id_ = x_2) ∧ (x_3.tenant = x_1.«by».tenant)))

(∀ (x : CrmStore), (∀ (x_1 : WriteCmd), ((((Crm.keepsRecords x (write x x_1)) ∧ (Crm.othersKept x x_1 (write x x_1))) ∧ (Crm.takesEffect x x_1 (write x x_1))) ∧ (Crm.onlyAsked x x_1 (write x x_1)))))

@[frflow_defs] def keepsRecords (x : CrmStore) (x_1 : CrmStore) : Prop :=
  (∀ x_2 ∈ x.records, (x_2 ∈ x_1.records))

@[frflow_defs] def othersKept (x : CrmStore) (x_1 : WriteCmd) (x_2 : CrmStore) : Prop :=

@[frflow_defs] def othersRecords (x : CrmStore) (x_1 : TenantId) : (List CrmRecord) :=
  (List.filter (fun x_2 => decide (¬(x_2.tenant = x_1))) x.records)

@[frflow_defs] def takesEffect (x : CrmStore) (x_1 : WriteCmd) (x_2 : CrmStore) : Prop :=
  (match x_1.change with | Change.Add x_3 => (Crm.addTakes x x_1 (x_3 : CrmRecord) x_2) | Change.ShareWith x_3 x_4 x_5 => (Crm.shareTakes x x_1 (x_3 : Int) (x_4 : TenantId) (x_5 : (Option Int)) x_2) | Change.Unshare x_3 x_4 => (Crm.unshareTakes x x_1 (x_3 : Int) (x_4 : TenantId) x_2))

@[frflow_defs] def addTakes (x : CrmStore) (x_1 : WriteCmd) (x_2 : CrmRecord) (x_3 : CrmStore) : Prop :=
  ((Crm.freshAdd x x_1 x_2) → (x_2 ∈ x_3.records))

@[frflow_defs] def freshAdd (x : CrmStore) (x_1 : WriteCmd) (x_2 : CrmRecord) : Prop :=
  ((x_2.tenant = x_1.«by».tenant) ∧ (¬(∃ x_3 ∈ x.records, (x_3.id_ = x_2.id_))))

@[frflow_defs] def shareTakes (x : CrmStore) (x_1 : WriteCmd) (x_2 : Int) (x_3 : TenantId) (x_4 : (Option Int)) (x_5 : CrmStore) : Prop :=
  ((Crm.ownRecord x x_1 x_2) → (Crm.sharedUntil x_5 x_2 x_3 x_4))

@[frflow_defs] def ownRecord (x : CrmStore) (x_1 : WriteCmd) (x_2 : Int) : Prop :=
  (∃ x_3 ∈ x.records, ((x_3.id_ = x_2) ∧ (x_3.tenant = x_1.«by».tenant)))

@[frflow_defs] def sharedUntil (x : CrmStore) (x_1 : Int) (x_2 : TenantId) (x_3 : (Option Int)) : Prop :=
  (((Share.mk x_1 x_2) ∈ x.shares) ∧ (Crm.shareTimeIs x x_1 x_2 x_3))

@[frflow_defs] def shareTimeIs (x : CrmStore) (x_1 : Int) (x_2 : TenantId) (x_3 : (Option Int)) : Prop :=
  (match x_3 with | none => (Crm.noTimeFor x x_1 x_2) | some x_4 => (Crm.onlyTime x x_1 x_2 x_4))

@[frflow_defs] def noTimeFor (x : CrmStore) (x_1 : Int) (x_2 : TenantId) : Prop :=
  (¬(∃ x_3 ∈ x.expiries, ((x_3.record = x_1) ∧ (x_3.to = x_2))))
